input.quote: Garman is the owner of all intellectual property rights in the Work (including any Improvements or Modifications thereto), including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 13 vests ownership of all IP in the Work, including the Schedule "D" Modifications built and paid for by Sparkling, in Garman, with no licence-back beyond the narrow non-transferable object-code licence in Section 2 and no statement that Sparkling's data (including data converted under Section 4(b)) and supplied materials remain ours; the sweep-up for "all related materials... provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement" could capture our own inputs. That fails the rule's requirement that we own what we pay for and assign nothing of ours to the Vendor. Because the bargain is an object-code licence to Garman's platform with escrow (Section 16), we took the fallback: Garman keeps its platform IP, we carve out our data and materials, take a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to the Modifications and Improvements, and rule out joint ownership.

proposal.summary: Carve Sparkling's data and materials out of Garman's IP ownership claim, add a perpetual royalty-free licence to Modifications and Improvements we pay for, and bar joint ownership.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 13 gives Garman ownership of everything "provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement", including the Schedule "D" Modifications we commission and pay for, with no licence-back and no confirmation that our data stays ours. We have accepted that Garman keeps its platform (our preferred position is that we own work product created for us), so as a fallback we have carved out our data and materials and taken a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to the Modifications and Improvements, and confirmed there is no joint ownership.

ops.oldText: including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.
ops.newText: including all related materials, logos, and names provided by Garman pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. Except for the licences granted to Sparkling under this Agreement, no title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.

ops.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing: (a) Sparkling retains all right, title and interest in and to Sparkling's data (including data converted under Section 4(b)) and all materials, information and specifications supplied by Sparkling, none of which is assigned or licensed to Garman except as reasonably necessary for Garman to perform its obligations under this Agreement; (b) Garman grants to Sparkling a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use the Modifications and the Improvements, and to modify them (itself or through a third party acting on its behalf), in the conduct of the business of Sparkling and its affiliated companies; and (c) nothing in this Agreement creates or is intended to create joint ownership of any intellectual property rights.
